definition: A worksheet for calculating the deductible this document for members of the Armed Forces on active duty who relocate due to a permanent change of station, including household goods transportation and travel costs.

includes.text: Calculates moving expense deduction for military personnel
Contains line items for household goods and travel expenses
includes.quote: Which Moving Expenses Are Deductible and Which Aren't

includes.text: Specifies storage and insurance of household goods within transit period
includes.quote: Storing and insuring household goods and personal effects

excludes.text: Reports rental property income and losses across multiple properties
Reports farm business income and expenses
Reports employee business expenses for all occupations

discriminators.text: This worksheet calculates a single deduction for military relocation; the sibling reports income and losses from rental real estate and other supplemental sources
This worksheet is limited to military this document; the sibling reports comprehensive farm business profit or loss including crops, livestock, and farm operations
This worksheet applies only to Armed Forces members relocating due to permanent change of station; the sibling covers employee business expenses for all workers in any occupation
